name: Ally Financial Inc.
share_adj_basis: applied to revenue components only (v5.4); OE/share CAGR enters unadjusted

overrides_applied.source: Anchor: FY2025 property and equipment depreciation of $243M, printed in the Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-25), other operating expenses table (with $224M for FY2024 and $196M for FY2023 in the same table) — the top of the filer's own filed FY2023-FY2025 range for that line; net property and equipment was $1,150M at FY2025 (Note 13) on $196,002M of total assets
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:capex — capex missing for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 (and every other year) under every candidate tag: EDGAR companyfacts for CIK 40729 contains no PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment fact in any period, and Ally's Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows present no purchases-of-property-and-equipment line in FY2023, FY2024 or FY2025 — premises/IT spend is folded into investing 'Other, net' (-$600M in FY2025) and cannot be isolated from the filing (the EWBC situation in this sweep). Maintenance PPE capex for this digital bank (IT hardware/software, premises, leasehold) is therefore proxied by its own filed PPE depreciation — the standard maintenance-capex proxy — at the top of the filed range, the conservative end. The figure is immaterial to the verdict either way: the scored base is the NI-based base_override (net income already carries the $243M depreciation charge), and $243M is ~$0.78/share against the rejected $14.60/share OCF-based base.

overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-25), Consolidated Statement of Changes in Equity, line 'Share-based compensation': $153M for FY2025, with $167M for FY2024 and $159M for FY2023 in the same statement; corroborated by Note 23 (Share-based Compensation Plans), which reports PSU/RSU expense of $130M / $136M / $127M for FY2025 / FY2024 / FY2023 — the equity-statement line is the broader total (it also carries ESPP/DSU-type awards)
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc — SBC missing for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 under the engine's tags: AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense was last filed for FY2020 ($80M in financials_history.csv) and ShareBasedCompensation is not filed at all, so the expense survives only in the equity statement and Note 23. The engine applies this single FY2025 value to every missing period: it understates FY2024 SBC by $14M and FY2023 by $6M against the same statement (raising those years' OE slightly, ~0.3% of OCF — immaterial and noted, not hidden); FY2025 is exact. Against the last engine-filed value ($80M, FY2020) the value is 1.9x, inside the 0.1x-10x band. SBC is already expensed inside net income, so it does not double-charge the NI-based base_override; it charges the engine's OCF-based history, which is where the gap blocked the tier.
